grant_type.description: The OAuth grant type. Use authorization_code for code exchange, or refresh_token to exchange a refresh token for an access token.

client_secret.description: Required for confidential clients. Public DCR/CIMD clients omit this field and use PKCE.

subject_token.description: Identity token to exchange; required for urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange.

subject_token_type.description: Subject token type; use urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:id_token for identity token exchange.

requested_token_type.description: Requested token type for identity token exchange.

audience.description: Target audience for identity token exchange.

code.description: Authorization code; required when grant_type is authorization_code.

refresh_token.description: The refresh token; required when grant_type is refresh_token.

redirect_uri.description: Redirect URI; required when grant_type is authorization_code.

code_verifier.description: Original PKCE verifier; required for public-client code exchange.

resource.description: Exact resource from authorization; canonical issuer for REST or issuer/mcp for MCP. Required for DCR and CIMD.

scope.description: Optional narrower subset during refresh; cannot add scopes.

client_assertion.description: Signed JWT proving client identity (RFC 7523); required with client_assertion_type for private_key_jwt clients using the client_credentials grant.

client_assertion_type.description: Must be urn:ietf:params:oauth:client-assertion-type:jwt-bearer when client_assertion is set.
